# glad: OpenGL loader of the OpenGL backend

Generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) (ADR-0009). Do not edit these files; regenerate them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Generator | glad2 2.0.8 (`pip install glad2==2.0.8`) |
| API | OpenGL 4.5 core |
| Extensions | `GL_KHR_debug`, `GL_ARB_gl_spirv`, `GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic` |
| Options | `--mx` (function pointers in a `GladGLContext` owned by the device, no global loader state); no built-in loader (functions are loaded through `platform::OpenGlContext::getProcAddress`) |
| Specification | the `gl.xml` bundled with glad2 2.0.8 (`--reproducible`) |
| License | generated code: `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0`; `KHR/khrplatform.h`: MIT-style Khronos license (see the file headers) |

## Regenerating

From the repository root, in a virtual environment:

```sh
python -m pip install glad2==2.0.8
python -m glad --reproducible --api "gl:core=4.5" \
    --extensions "GL_KHR_debug,GL_ARB_gl_spirv,GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic" \
    --out-path engine/rhi/backends/opengl/third_party/glad c --mx
```

`--reproducible` uses the specification bundled with the generator instead of downloading the Khronos registry's current `main`, so the same command always produces the same files. Changing the version or the extension list is a change to ADR-0009's decision: update the ADR's list together with this README.

The files are compiled into `teserra_glad`, which only `teserra_rhi_opengl` links (`PRIVATE`). They are excluded from formatting, clang-tidy and the leak checks (`third_party/`).
